items.headline: Radiant puts over $100M into El Segundo plant to assemble first commercial Kaleidos
items.what_happened: Radiant announced a new headquarters and manufacturing facility in El Segundo, California, an investment of more than $100 million that adds about 200,000 square feet and lets it assemble several Kaleidos units in parallel. Its 81-acre Oak Ridge, Tennessee campus (about $280 million planned) will fuel and refuel reactors, with fueling operations expected in 2027 and commercial deliveries from 2028.
items.why_it_matters: A buyer gets a reactor fueled and sealed at the factory, so the customer site needs no in-ground nuclear construction. The fueling plant still needs its NRC Part 70 license, which the NRC targets for January 2027.
items.binding_note: A company announcement of facilities and spending, not a contract or a regulatory approval.
